Replace the empty string with your SQL query:

def q1():
    """..."""
    return """
        SELECT p.name AS player_name, p.position, c.name AS club_name
        FROM players p
        JOIN clubs c ON p.club_id = c.club_id
        ORDER BY p.name;
    """

Each question is graded on five criteria:
— the query runs without errors (required to earn any points)
— aliases match what the docstring specifies
— rows appear in the specified order
Partial credit is not awarded per question — each query is either fully correct or not.
Work through the questions in order. The early questions build the muscle memory for the patterns you will need in the harder ones. When you’re stuck, add a temporary
query to look at the raw data — understanding what’s in the table is usually the fastest way to unstick yourself. Good luck! ⚽
